description: This file defines the ExtraFieldBlockDeriver class, which provides entity field block definitions for fields in Drupal's layout builder module. It includes methods for constructing the class, creating instances via dependency injection, generating derivative definitions for entity fields, and retrieving entity type and bundle information with layout builder enabled.

classes.name: ExtraFieldBlockDeriver
classes.description: A class that derives block definitions for entity fields in Drupal's layout builder, providing dynamic derivative definitions based on entity types, bundles, and extra fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with required services via dependency injection.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the class using the service container.

methods.name: getDerivativeDefinitions
methods.description: Generates derivative definitions for entity fields, including category, admin label, and context definitions.

methods.name: bundleIdsWithLayoutBuilderDisplays
methods.description: Retrieves entity type and bundle IDs where layout builder is enabled.
